tests.name: desktop secrets use the main-process OS storage adapter
refuses unavailable or unprotected OS storage (false, undefined)
refuses unavailable or unprotected OS storage (true, basic_text)

bindings.assertion: OS storage adapter round-trips encrypted fixture text, rejects plaintext and refuses unavailable/basic_text storage.
bindings.limitations: Unit adapter double only; does not prove real Keychain import, installed upgrade or credential rollback.

tests.name: only the trusted app renderer can write clipboard text
clipboard reading and unrelated permissions remain denied

bindings.assertion: Permission predicate accepts only the trusted renderer and origin for sanitized writes; rejects reads and unrelated permissions.
bindings.limitations: Predicate tests, not native clipboard interaction or Electron permission dialog acceptance.

tests.name: web links open in the system browser without creating an Electron window
scripts, files, custom protocols and relative URLs never reach the OS
a browser launch failure is handled without allowing an Electron popup

bindings.assertion: HTTP(S) requests reach the injected external opener while popup creation is denied; unsafe schemes and relative paths do not reach it; launch failures remain denied.
bindings.limitations: Injected opener only; not an OS browser-launch receipt.

tests.name: workspace preferences survive a new reader; invalid writes preserve the last complete file
synchronous saves are readable before reply and reject untrusted senders without changing disk
workspace IPC accepts only the application window main frame at the current origin

bindings.assertion: Temporary-file preferences survive a new reader; invalid JSON/schema and untrusted writes preserve disk data; frame and origin checks reject other senders.
bindings.limitations: Isolated JSON file and sender doubles; not installed-user migration or full UI restart restoration.

tests.name: stable SemVer comparison rejects prereleases, invalid tags, equal versions and downgrades
concurrent checks/downloads share work; snapshots survive UI subscriptions
unsupported development mode never contacts the update source

bindings.assertion: check/download use one active task and return shared promises; state snapshots reflect transitions; invalid/equal/older versions do not download; unsupported mode never contacts its adapter.
bindings.limitations: Injected update adapter; shared internal run/setState are associated only with these transitions, not all branches or real release download.

tests.name: cancellation is recoverable and a failed download can be retried

bindings.assertion: Cancel aborts the active injected download and returns available state; ENOSPC becomes a visible error and retry succeeds.
bindings.limitations: Unit state machine and injected download; not cancellation of a real release transfer.

tests.name: install only runs after an explicit request and successful backend cleanup
time spent deciding whether to close terminals never starts shutdown or expires the installer
failed or timed-out cleanup never installs, including late cleanup completion
macOS stages the verified download before cleanup and installs only on explicit request
staged application is disposed after failed or timed-out backend cleanup and failed handoff

bindings.assertion: Explicit install waits for close confirmation and cleanup, never installs after failed/timed-out cleanup, prepares before closing and disposes staged resources on failures.
bindings.limitations: Injected installer/backend only; does not satisfy installed-upgrade-rollback or native-update gates.

tests.name: a manually deleted DMG can be downloaded again

bindings.assertion: ENOENT while opening the injected downloaded file clears the stale download and allows a new download.
bindings.limitations: Only missing-file error recovery; not successful native open/reveal or every openFile branch.

tests.name: IPC rejects other windows, child frames, external origins and all renderer arguments

bindings.assertion: Update handler registration exposes state only to the trusted frame; unexpected download arguments reject; dispose removes handlers and state listeners.
bindings.limitations: Fake IPC/window boundary; not preload execution, every update channel or native update completion.

tests.name: macOS selects the correct architecture, verifies SHA-256 and atomically completes the DMG
macOS rejects incomplete, corrupt or oversized downloads and removes partial files
macOS removes partial downloads on cancellation and stalled response timeout

bindings.assertion: Injected HTTP release/download responses choose the requested architecture and verify checksum before atomic completion; corrupt/oversized/cancelled/stalled transfers leave no partial files.
bindings.limitations: Synthetic DMG bytes and injected fetch; not online update, another architecture's runtime or a signed installation.

tests.name: Electron adapter disables automatic installation, handles retry cancellation and relays native install errors
Electron adapter reports check and stalled-download timeouts

bindings.assertion: Adapter disables automatic installation, cancels injected downloads on abort, relays install errors, and reports check/download timeouts.
bindings.limitations: Injected Electron updater emitter on local Mac; not a Windows/Linux native update receipt.

tests.name: macOS prepares on the same filesystem, validates copied bundle and detaches the DMG
macOS rejects wrong bundle identity, version, binary architecture and failed copy without altering the app
non-writable application directory is rejected before mounting or stopping the app
helper restores and relaunches the old app when replacement or launch fails

bindings.assertion: Isolated application fixture stages beside the destination, validates identity/version/architecture, detaches and cleans up; invalid copy/permissions preserve the app; helper failure restores the old fixture.
bindings.limitations: Synthetic app fixtures and command/launcher adapters for these selected assertions; not actual Alune credentials or production-version rollback.
